from vllm import LLM, SamplingParams
import json

llm = LLM(model='checkpoints/qwen3-8b-scierc-merged-v2/', max_model_len=2048, gpu_memory_utilization=0.4, enforce_eager=True)
params = SamplingParams(n=1, temperature=1.0, max_tokens=50, logprobs=1)
out = llm.generate(['Extract entities: The MIT team published results.'], params)
o = out[0].outputs[0]
print('=== logprobs type ===')
print(type(o.logprobs))
if o.logprobs:
    print('len:', len(o.logprobs))
    print('element type:', type(o.logprobs[0]))
    elem = o.logprobs[0]
    print('element:', elem)
    if isinstance(elem, dict):
        for k, v in elem.items():
            print(f'  key type={type(k)}, val type={type(v)}')
            if hasattr(v, 'logprob'): print(f'  logprob={v.logprob}')
            if hasattr(v, 'decoded_token'): print(f'  decoded_token={v.decoded_token}')
            if hasattr(v, 'rank'): print(f'  rank={v.rank}')
            break
print('=== token_ids ===')
print(o.token_ids[:5])
print('=== text ===')
print(repr(o.text[:100]))
"

with open('output/exp_entity_token_lp_smoke/samples.jsonl') as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        d = json.loads(line)
        s = d['samples'][0]
        has_tl = 'token_logprobs' in s
        has_tt = 'token_texts' in s
        n_tl = len(s.get('token_logprobs', []))
        n_tt = len(s.get('token_texts', []))
        n_tok = s.get('n_tokens', -1)
        recon = ''.join(s.get('token_texts', []))
        print(f'inst {i}: token_logprobs={has_tl}({n_tl}), token_texts={has_tt}({n_tt}), n_tokens={n_tok}, match={n_tl==n_tok}')
        if i == 0:
            print(f'  first 5 tokens: {s.get("token_texts", [])[:5]}')
            print(f'  first 5 lps: {s.get("token_logprobs", [])[:5]}')
            print(f'  text snippet: {recon[:80]}...')
